archive: run workspace (copy taken before the host workspace was deleted)

pointer_roots.harness: the harness state directory of the run host

scaffold_version.method: the CLI version stamped on every record of the agent's own session transcripts (3116 records, 2.1.223: 3116)

evidence.field: rows for this model in the run window: 1011

route.method: 1011 gateway ledger rows (one per model call) for this model inside the run window, each resolved to an OpenRouter generation record

evidence.field: provider of each generation id of this run

provider_pin.method: provider field of the OpenRouter generation record fetched for every gateway call of the run (reconciliation)

reasoning_effort.method: the effort field Claude Code stamped on each assistant record (high/None: 2027)
reasoning_effort.note: the harness passes --effort only to the claudesub scaffold, so the gateway scaffold ran at the CLI default. Whether the gateway forwarded the level to the provider is not recorded (the ledger shows reasoning tokens)

campaign_id.method: the batch gate record at the top of the trajectory (admission and GO time) and the experiment name the harness wrote at admission

freeze_id.method: sha256 of the freeze manifest the freeze guard checked at admission (first 16 hex digits). Guard state: development mode, not enforced, verdict PASS

eligible_s.method: the harness eligible clock at the end of the run: wall time minus credited provider pauses

wall_s.method: wall time from the start event to the end of the run

credited_pauses.method: count of eligible_pause events with credited seconds > 0 (0 s credited in total)

completion.method: end status complete and eligible time at or above the eligible budget

max_context_tokens.method: largest prompt_tokens (uncached plus cached input, as billed) over the 1011 gateway calls of the run. 0 calls exceeded 200,000

cross_check.note: the transcript usage of gateway arms passes through the gateway translation and is not the billed figure

compactions.method: system records with subtype compact_boundary in the transcripts

jin_pdf_read.method: A call counts as reading the PDF when a tool call that touches the PDF (a Read of the .pdf, or a shell command naming the file or a PDF library) returns at least 1,500 characters containing at least three of: thermocline, recharge, discharge, zonal, equatorial, Kelvin, Rossby, oscillator, wind stress, Sverdrup. Each hit was then checked by hand.

jin_pdf_method.value: shell: pypdf installed with pip --break-system-packages at the start, PyPDF2 later, page text printed

network_condition.method: fresh downloads from the package index

evidence.field: total_cost of the 1011 generation ids of this run

cost_usd.method: sum of OpenRouter per-generation total_cost over all 1011 calls (100% priced). The account delta was never closed: the batch guard stopped sampling at 17:55Z on 2026-09-12 with the disk-full event, at $2.66 after 2.1 h. The account rose $6.60 between this batch's baseline and the next armed baseline (smokeF2-0913), which bounds the run from above and also contains 9 gateway probe calls made before that smoke

cost_basis.value: per-generation reconciled (account delta not closed, bounded by 2.66 to 6.60)

checkpoints.method: eligible seconds of each snapshot = (snapshot time minus start time) minus credited pause seconds settled before it, with the clock frozen during a pause (the harness rule). Snapshot event round r is folder round_{r+1}. Folder modification times match the event times within 0.1 s. The computed values agree with the harness's own elapsed_min stamp to within 0.5 s (its 0.1 min rounding)

unknown.reason: the cost guard of formal6H-20260912 stopped at the 17:55Z disk-full event, so the key-usage delta at run end was never recorded. The per-generation figure is reported instead

configuration_vs_evidence: run_meta records reasoning effort medium, but every assistant record in the transcript shows effort high: the gateway scaffold was never given --effort.
the freeze guard ran in development mode and was not enforced (run_meta mode = development). The manifest digest ccf4a2da6a29da1f still matched (verdict PASS).
